label: SELF-TEST: operating wallet paying its own StillCurrent service (payer == payTo). Not revenue.

body.message: StillCurrent /verify/payment costs $0.02 in USDC on eip155:8453. Payment requirements are in the PAYMENT-REQUIRED response header (base64-encoded JSON).

resource.description: Verify a claimed USDC payment on Base: given a tx hash (or an x402 PAYMENT-RESPONSE header) and what you expect (payee, payer, amount, time window, confirmations), reads the chain and returns match / mismatch / not_settled / not_found with per-field checks, finality, the x402 EIP-3009 pattern, a self-payment flag and a second-RPC cross-check. Cannot show who owns an address or that a service was delivered.

tx_hash.description: Base mainnet transaction hash of the claimed payment. Give this or payment_response.
tx_hash.title: Tx Hash

payment_response.description: Alternative to tx_hash: the base64 PAYMENT-RESPONSE (or X-PAYMENT-RESPONSE) header a seller returned after an x402 settlement. The transaction hash (and payer, if named) are taken from it.
payment_response.title: Payment Response

expect.description: The claim to check. Give at least one of payee, payer, amount_usdc, amount_atomic. Every field you give must be satisfied by one single USDC Transfer in the transaction.

payee.description: Address that should have received the USDC.

payer.description: Address that should have sent the USDC.

amount_usdc.description: Decimal USDC amount with at most 6 decimals, e.g. "0.02". A JSON number is accepted too.

amount_atomic.description: Same amount in USDC base units (6 decimals), e.g. "20000". If both are given they must agree.

min_confirmations.description: Require at least this many blocks on top (inclusive of the block itself). Base blocks are about 2 s apart.

not_before.description: ISO-8601 time or unix seconds: the block must be at or after this.

not_after.description: ISO-8601 time or unix seconds: the block must be at or before this.

x402.description: true: require the EIP-3009 AuthorizationUsed pattern an x402 'exact' payment leaves; false: require its absence.

cross_check.description: Ask a second, independent RPC node for the same receipt and report whether it agrees.

verdict.description: match: every supplied field satisfied by one USDC Transfer in a successful tx. mismatch: tx is real but a field differs (see checks). not_settled: tx reverted. no_usdc_transfer: succeeded but moved no native USDC. not_found: no queried node has the receipt (absence of evidence, not proof).

transfers.description: Native-USDC Transfer logs in the transaction (max 25).

checked_at.description: UTC time the chain was read. Finality and confirmations are as of this time.

body.explanation: Settled: the transaction succeeded and the chain shows a USDC Transfer of 0.10 from 0x33190c9d2662f94a19ce88ea666f0ff8cede3700 to 0x33190c9d2662f94a19ce88ea666f0ff8cede3700 that satisfies every field you supplied.

checks.expected: a single Transfer log satisfying every field

x402.note: x402 'exact' payments are EIP-3009 authorizations: the payer signs, a facilitator submits and pays gas (often through a Multicall3 contract), so submitted_by is usually the facilitator, not the payer. The pattern shows an EIP-3009 authorization was consumed for that sender; it does not by itself prove the payment was made through x402.

counterparty.note: self_payment=true means payer and payee are the same address: the transfer is real but is not outside demand. Whether the payer is related to the payee in any other way (funded by, same operator) is NOT assessed.

evidence.reproduce: eth_getTransactionReceipt(0x2d3fd6ac0f26fb81d8763c0a4dc723a3e209a9a5da12946cdc6c20dd587666c1) on any Base mainnet RPC; decode logs from 0x833589fcd6edb6e08f4c7c32d4f71b54bda02913: Transfer topic 0xddf252ad1be2c89b69c2b068fc378daa952ba7f163c4a11628f55a4df523b3ef, AuthorizationUsed topic 0x98de503528ee59b575ef0c0a2576a82497bfc029a5685b209e9ec333479b10a5.

caveats: Block time and confirmations could not be read from any node; time and confirmation checks are unevaluated.
No second RPC node answered, so this verdict has a single witness.
limits: Reads Base mainnet state through public RPC nodes. A match means the chain shows a USDC Transfer with those fields in a successful transaction; it does not show who controls either address, that goods or services were delivered, or where the payer's funds came from.
Only native USDC on Base (0x8335...2913) is checked. Other tokens and other chains are not.
